name: George Burgess
bio: George Burgess is an English professional rugby league footballer. In 2019, Burgess made his acting debut in the Australian/New Zealand crime thriller Locusts.

credits.title: The Only One
credits.overview: When her exes are suddenly being murdered one by one, suspicion falls on Zoe and it's up to her and a ragtag team of old friends to prove her innocence and figure out the identity of the masked Prince Charming killer.

credits.title: The Weight
credits.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

credits.title: Lewis Crocker vs. Liam Paro
credits.overview: Lewis Crocker defends his IBF Welterweight title against Liam Paro at the Pat Rafter Arena in Brisbane, Australia.

credits.title: Beast
credits.overview: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

credits.title: Land of Bad
credits.overview: When a Delta Force special ops mission goes terribly wrong, Air Force drone pilot Reaper has 48 hours to remedy what has devolved into a wild rescue operation. credits.title: Ascendant
credits.overview: A young environmentalist wakes, trapped, kidnapped in the elevator of a super high rise building at the mercy of her tormentors.

credits.title: Locusts
credits.overview: Two estranged brothers who are reluctantly reunited in their remote hometown at their father's funeral, become the target of an extortion scam at the hands of a gang of violent local thugs.
